name: encoding.binary
doc:
encoding.binary: fixed-size integers in big/little endian, varints,
and Encode/Decode/Read/Write of whole structs through compile-time
reflection (each instance is straight-line code for its type).

Byte orders as static methods, like Go: binary.BigEndian.Uint32(b),
binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(b, v). As a value (for Encode/Read):
binary.ByteOrder.BigEndian / LittleEndian. A struct or field can override the order
with the attribute @binary(endian: "big") / "little".

items.name: MaxVarintLen16
items.doc: Maximum length of a varint-encoded integer of that size, in bytes.
items.summary: Maximum length of a varint-encoded integer of that size, in bytes.

items.name: MaxVarintLen32
items.doc: Maximum length of a varint-encoded integer of that size, in bytes.
items.summary: Maximum length of a varint-encoded integer of that size, in bytes.

items.name: MaxVarintLen64
items.doc: Maximum length of a varint-encoded integer of that size, in bytes.
items.summary: Maximum length of a varint-encoded integer of that size, in bytes.

items.name: AppendUvarint
items.doc: Appends the unsigned varint (LEB128) encoding of x.
items.summary: Appends the unsigned varint (LEB128) encoding of x.

items.name: AppendVarint
items.doc: Appends the zig-zag signed varint encoding of x.
items.summary: Appends the zig-zag signed varint encoding of x.

items.name: Decode
items.doc: Decodes a T from the start of b (see Encode); error if b is too short.
items.summary: Decodes a T from the start of b (see Encode); error if b is too short.

items.name: Encode
items.doc:
The encoding of v: integers and floats in order (floats as IEEE bits
via float bits of the same width), bool as one byte, fixed arrays
element by element, structs field by field (each may override the
order with @binary). int and uint are 8 bytes.
items.summary: The encoding of v: integers and floats in order (floats as IEEE bits via float bits of the same width), bool as one byte, fixed arrays element by element, structs field by field (each may override the order with @binary).

items.name: PutUvarint
items.doc:
Writes the uvarint of x into b (which must be long enough, at most
MaxVarintLen64 bytes) and returns the number of bytes written.
items.summary: Writes the uvarint of x into b (which must be long enough, at most MaxVarintLen64 bytes) and returns the number of bytes written.

items.name: PutVarint
items.doc: Writes the varint of x into b; returns the number of bytes written.
items.summary: Writes the varint of x into b; returns the number of bytes written.

items.name: Read
items.signature: func Read<T>(r io.Reader, order ByteOrder) T!
items.doc: Reads Size<T>() bytes from r and decodes them (io.ReadFull semantics).
items.summary: Reads Size<T>() bytes from r and decodes them (io.ReadFull semantics).

items.name: Size
items.doc:
The encoded size of a T: fixed-size integers, floats, bool (1 byte),
arrays and structs of those. Panics for other types.
items.summary: The encoded size of a T: fixed-size integers, floats, bool (1 byte), arrays and structs of those.

items.name: Uvarint
items.doc:
Decodes a uvarint from b: (value, bytes read); n == 0 if b is too
short, n < 0 (-bytes read) on 64-bit overflow, as in Go.
items.summary: Decodes a uvarint from b: (value, bytes read); n == 0 if b is too short, n < 0 (-bytes read) on 64-bit overflow, as in Go.

items.name: Varint
items.doc: Decodes a zig-zag varint from b: (value, bytes read), n as in Uvarint.
items.summary: Decodes a zig-zag varint from b: (value, bytes read), n as in Uvarint.

items.name: Write
items.signature: func Write<T>(w io.Writer, order ByteOrder, v T) void!
items.doc: Writes the encoding of v to w.
items.summary: Writes the encoding of v to w.

items.name: BigEndian
items.doc: Big-endian (network order) access to byte slices.
items.summary: Big-endian (network order) access to byte slices.
